title: 2027 UTMB Mont-Blanc Regulations — Equipment
claims: Organizers publish a mandatory basic equipment list applicable to all runners, plus additional items that can be activated individually depending on the forecast; runners must start with all basic and activated additional items.
All mandatory equipment must be carried in a pack or belt, accessible and checkable at any time during the race; marshals can verify packs, and refusal to comply can lead to disqualification.
Absence of mandatory safety equipment (water reserve, hooded waterproof jacket, headlamp, survival blanket, smartphone) is disqualifying; other missing mandatory equipment carries a time penalty.
Runners are advised not to choose the lightest possible clothing, but to carry clothing that gives adequate protection against cold, wind, heavy precipitation and snow in mountain terrain.

claimVerification.note: EQUIPMENT 段：basic equipment 全员强制；additional equipment 按天气 24 小时前激活，出发时须全部携带。
规程：装备须放在背包或腰包内，随时可出示；裁判可在途中抽查，拒绝检查可被取消资格。
PENALTIES 表：缺少安全强制装备（饮水、带帽防水外套、头灯、保温毯、手机）直接取消资格；其他强制装备缺失处时间罚。
EQUIPMENT 段原文：不要一味选最轻服装，应选择能防风、防雨、抗雪与低温的保护层。
